title: Beta Jappa Connected Glasses
description: Ah, finally, connected beta Jappa glasses!
body:
Ah, finally, connected beta Jappa glasses! Very very niche texture pack, but I know some wanted lol.

This texture pack allows the beta Jappa glasses to be connected, because I have yet to see other packs to the same thing without Continuity atleast.

Works on Optifine for y'all optifine players (me)
